A '''thug''' led a group of ruffians aboard [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] in [[137 ABY]]. [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Morrigan Corde]] hired him to approach rival agent [[Jor Torlin]] due to his resemblance to [[Cade Skywalker]]. Torlin was [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] for Skywalker, and Corde needed the thug and his posse to get Torlin's attention in order to establish contact. A brawl ensued, and the thug was carried away by his friends after a sound beating.
